The hex pocket is 8.35 mm across flats; 7.80 mm is only the gap between the flexible retaining lips, not the full pocket width. The coupon is optional and is not part of the finished one-piece knob.","params":{"nut_af":{"value":8,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"nut_h":{"value":4.7,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"bolt_d":{"value":5,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"knob_d":{"value":30,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"height":{"value":9,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"floor":{"value":3,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"hex_allowance":{"value":0.35,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Total across-flats allowance."},"bore_allowance":{"value":0.6,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"snap_overlap":{"value":0.1,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Overlap per finger relative to nominal nut flat."},"finger_t":{"value":0.9,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"finger_w":{"value":3,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"relief":{"value":0.8,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"slot_start":{"value":2,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"nut_axial_play":{"value":0.25,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"lip_land":{"value":0.3,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"scallop_count":{"value":12,"unit":"count","kind":"design","source":"design"},"scallop_radius":{"value":2,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"scallop_offset":{"value":16,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"coupon_d":{"value":16,"kind":"design","source":"design"}},"parts":[{"id":"knob","role":"final","material":"PLA","code":"import math

def build(p):
    a=(p.nut_af+p.hex_allowance)/2
    outer=a+p.finger_t
    throat=p.nut_af/2-p.snap_overlap
    lip_z=p.floor+p.nut_h+p.nut_axial_play
    body=cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.knob_d/2).extrude(p.height)
    for k in range(int(p.scallop_count)):
        t=2*math.pi*k/p.scallop_count
        cut=cq.Workplane('XY').center(p.scallop_offset*math.cos(t),p.scallop_offset*math.sin(t)).circle(p.scallop_radius).extrude(p.height)
        body=body.cut(cut)
    verts=[(a/math.cos(math.pi/6)*math.cos(math.pi/6+k*math.pi/3),a/math.cos(math.pi/6)*math.sin(math.pi/6+k*math.pi/3)) for k in range(6)]
    body=body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.floor).polyline(verts).close().extrude(p.height-p.floor))
    body=body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_d+p.bore_allowance)/2).extrude(p.height))
    for angle in (0,180):
        slots=cq.Workplane('XY').box(p.relief,p.finger_w+2*p.relief,p.height-p.slot_start,centered=(True,True,False)).translate((outer+p.relief/2,0,p.slot_start))
        for sign in (-1,1):
            side=cq.Workplane('XY').box(p.finger_t+p.relief,p.relief,p.height-p.slot_start,centered=(True,True,False)).translate(((a+outer+p.relief)/2,sign*(p.finger_w/2+p.relief/2),p.slot_start))
            slots=slots.union(side)
        body=body.cut(slots.rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),angle))
        lip=cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline([(a,lip_z),(throat,lip_z),(throat,lip_z+p.lip_land),(a,p.height)]).close().extrude(p.finger_w/2,both=True)
        body=body.union(lip.rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),angle))
    return body
","print_orientation":"Closed flat underside on bed at z=0; hex pocket upward. No supports.","use_orientation":"Nut enters from the pocket side; bolt passes through the underside hole and nut."},{"id":"fit_coupon","role":"coupon","material":"PLA","code":"import math

def build(p):
    a=(p.nut_af+p.hex_allowance)/2
    outer=a+p.finger_t
    throat=p.nut_af/2-p.snap_overlap
    lip_z=p.floor+p.nut_h+p.nut_axial_play
    body=cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.coupon_d/2).extrude(p.height)
    verts=[(a/math.cos(math.pi/6)*math.cos(math.pi/6+k*math.pi/3),a/math.cos(math.pi/6)*math.sin(math.pi/6+k*math.pi/3)) for k in range(6)]
    body=body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.floor).polyline(verts).close().extrude(p.height-p.floor))
    body=body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_d+p.bore_allowance)/2).extrude(p.height))
    for angle in (0,180):
        slots=cq.Workplane('XY').box(p.relief,p.finger_w+2*p.relief,p.height-p.slot_start,centered=(True,True,False)).translate((outer+p.relief/2,0,p.slot_start))
        for sign in (-1,1):
            side=cq.Workplane('XY').box(p.finger_t+p.relief,p.relief,p.height-p.slot_start,centered=(True,True,False)).translate(((a+outer+p.relief)/2,sign*(p.finger_w/2+p.relief/2),p.slot_start))
            slots=slots.union(side)
        body=body.cut(slots.rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),angle))
        lip=cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline([(a,lip_z),(throat,lip_z),(throat,lip_z+p.lip_land),(a,p.height)]).close().extrude(p.finger_w/2,both=True)
        body=body.union(lip.rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),angle))
    return body

Nut remains captured when inverted and gently shaken; no cracks or permanently bent fingers."}},{"id":"bolt_clearance","part":"knob","feature":"Through bore aligned with nut","relation":"clears","hardware":"bolt","params":["bolt_d","bore_allowance"],"check":{"method":"coupon","ref":"fit_coupon","description":"Bolt passes freely through the printed hole, threads through the nut by hand, and emerges from the other side."}}],"manual":[{"n":"1","text":"Recommended: print fit_coupon first, pocket upward, in PLA at 0.2 mm layers with 4 walls and 30% infill. Use no supports. Cool completely and clear any strings from the finger slots.","parts":["fit_coupon"]},{"n":"2","text":"Align the nut flats to the hex pocket. Press straight down by thumb until the nut rests on the floor and both fingers return over it. Do not hammer or force it. Invert and gently shake: the nut must remain captured. Check bolt passage from the underside.","parts":["fit_coupon"],"hardware":["nut","bolt"]},{"n":"3","text":"If the lips require excessive force, reduce snap_overlap by 0.05 mm and retest. If the hex walls bind, increase hex_allowance by 0.10 mm. If the nut falls out, increase snap_overlap by 0.05 mm and retest. Reject cracked or permanently bent fingers. Recover the coupon nut by gently spreading the fingers just enough to release it while pushing upward through the bottom hole with the bolt tip; do not pry hard.","parts":["fit_coupon"],"hardware":["nut","bolt"]},{"n":"4","text":"Print knob using the tested parameters and identical settings. Clear strings and cool fully. Press the nut into its pocket as tested. Only knob and nut remain in the finished assembly; the coupon is not an assembly part.","parts":["knob"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"5","text":"Insert the bolt through the flat underside and thread it through the nut. The listed M5x20 is an example bolt; working length depends on your application. Turn the knob with modest hand force only. The nut is retained against rotation and falling out, but the bolt is not permanently locked to the knob. Avoid pliers, excessive torque, and heat.","parts":["knob"],"hardware":["nut","bolt"]}]}
